title: Design Delta
description: Per-delta record surfaced by Phase 5 skills during finalisation. Aggregated by phase-transition at Phase 5 exit; user reviews each during reconciliation pass; resolved by one of 4 reconciliation_options. Lives in `_context/handoffs/phase-5-design-deltas-wip-{date}.md` (WIP) → moved to `_context/handoffs/phase-5-to-6-{date}.md` design_deltas section at Phase 5 exit.

id.description: Sequential ID, zero-padded to 3 digits. e.g., delta-001, delta-014.

source_step.description: Which step in the source skill surfaced this delta. e.g., 'step-02-content', 'step-04-spec'.

prd_section.description: PRD section affected. e.g., 'User Stories §US-7', 'NFR a11y axis', 'Voice/Tone (implied via product-brief)'.

delta_type.description: additive = PRD missing this; modifying = PRD says X, design says Y'; removing = PRD includes scope design wants out; conflicting = direct contradiction; cross_phase_alignment = Phase 4 architecture decision conflicts with Phase 5 UI direction.

evidence.description: What observation triggered this. Quote / file path / step output reference.

reconciliation_options.description: Available options offered to user. Typically all 4.

user_decision.description: Set at reconciliation pass. Null until decided.

applied_at.description: When user_decision was executed (PRD amendment authored, ADR-required marker emitted, etc.).

applied_artefacts.description: Paths of artefacts updated as part of applying the decision (e.g., PRD v(N+1) path; ADR-required marker location).
